questions.title: Two Sum (W1)
questions.description:
Given an array of integers and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.

**Input Format**
First line: integer N (array size)
Second line: N integers
Third line: integer Target

**Output Format**
Two space-separated integers representing the indices.

questions.title: Maximum Subarray (W1)
questions.description:
Find the contiguous subarray (containing at least one number) which has the largest sum and return its sum.

**Input Format**
First line: integer N
Second line: N integers

**Output Format**
Single integer (the maximum sum).

questions.title: Valid Parentheses (W1)
questions.description:
Given a string containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid.

**Input Format**
String S on a single line.

**Output Format**
Print 'true' if valid, 'false' otherwise.

questions.title: Reverse Array Segment (W1)
questions.description:
Reverse the elements of an array from position m to p (0-indexed, inclusive).

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers
Third line: m p

**Output Format**
Space-separated integers of the modified array.

questions.title: Merge Intervals (W1)
questions.description:
Merge all overlapping intervals.

**Input Format**
First line: N (number of intervals)
Next N lines: Two integers representing start and end.

**Output Format**
Merged intervals, one per line (start end), sorted by start time.

questions.title: Longest Substring (W1)
questions.description:
Find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

**Input Format**
Single string S.

**Output Format**
Single integer representing the length.

questions.title: Container With Most Water (W1)
questions.description:
Given N non-negative integers representing heights of vertical lines, find two lines that form a container that holds the most water.

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers (heights)

**Output Format**
Maximum area.

questions.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array (W1)
questions.description:
Search for a target in a rotated sorted array.

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers
Third line: target

**Output Format**
Index of target, or -1 if not found.

questions.title: Climbing Stairs (W1)

Single integer representing number of ways.

Second line: N integers

'true' or 'false'.

Given an array containing n distinct numbers taken from 0, 1, 2, ..., n, find the one that is missing from the array.

**Input Format**
First line: N (the max number)
Second line: N integers

**Output Format**
Single integer (the missing number).

questions.title: Contains Duplicate (W7)
questions.description:
Given an integer array, return true if any value appears at least twice in the array, and return false if every element is distinct.

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers

**Output Format**
'true' or 'false'.

questions.title: Single Number (W7)
questions.description:
Given a non-empty array of integers, every element appears twice except for one. Find that single one.

**Input Format**
First line: N (odd)
Second line: N integers

**Output Format**
Single integer.

questions.title: Move Zeroes (W7)
questions.description:
Given an integer array, move all 0's to the end of it while maintaining the relative order of the non-zero elements.

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers

**Output Format**
Space-separated integers.

questions.title: Majority Element (W7)
questions.description:
Given an array of size n, find the majority element (appears more than n/2 times).

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers

**Output Format**
Single integer.

questions.title: Two Sum (W8)
questions.description:
Given an array of integers and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.

**Input Format**
First line: integer N (array size)
Second line: N integers
Third line: integer Target

**Output Format**
Two space-separated integers representing the indices.

questions.title: Maximum Subarray (W8)
questions.description:
Find the contiguous subarray (containing at least one number) which has the largest sum and return its sum.

**Input Format**
First line: integer N
Second line: N integers

**Output Format**
Single integer (the maximum sum).

questions.title: Valid Parentheses (W8)
questions.description:
Given a string containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid.

**Input Format**
String S on a single line.

**Output Format**
Print 'true' if valid, 'false' otherwise.

questions.title: Reverse Array Segment (W8)
questions.description:
Reverse the elements of an array from position m to p (0-indexed, inclusive).

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers
Third line: m p

**Output Format**
Space-separated integers of the modified array.

questions.title: Merge Intervals (W8)
questions.description:
Merge all overlapping intervals.

**Input Format**
First line: N (number of intervals)
Next N lines: Two integers representing start and end.

**Output Format**
Merged intervals, one per line (start end), sorted by start time.

questions.title: Longest Substring (W8)
questions.description:
Find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

**Input Format**
Single string S.

**Output Format**
Single integer representing the length.

questions.title: Container With Most Water (W8)
questions.description:
Given N non-negative integers representing heights of vertical lines, find two lines that form a container that holds the most water.

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers (heights)

**Output Format**
Maximum area.

questions.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array (W8)
questions.description:
Search for a target in a rotated sorted array.

**Input Format**
First line: N
Second line: N integers
Third line: target

**Output Format**
Index of target, or -1 if not found.

questions.title: Climbing Stairs (W8)
questions.description:
You are climbing a staircase. It takes n steps to reach the top. Each time you can either climb 1 or 2 steps. In how many distinct ways can you climb to the top?

**Input Format**
Single integer N.

**Output Format**
Single integer representing number of ways.

questions.title: Jump Game (W8)

Second line: N integers

**Output Format**
'true' or 'false'.
